bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This toy-breed puppy plan sequences doses against tiny-patient handling stress, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your dog.

Milestone labels on the toy-breed puppy table (8 weeks; 12 weeks; 16 weeks; 16 weeks) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished toy-breed puppy puppy series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with dental topics crowding the visit or missed doses after mild gi days, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the DA2PP / DHPP booster so one reminder system owns the toy-breed puppy week.

faqs.question: Is this toy breed puppy vaccine schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual dog.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this toy-breed puppy schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to tiny-patient handling stress, and reset reminders as soon as the next toy-breed puppy due date is known.
